name: app-shater-marketplace-craftsman-key-needs-arabic-slide
title: Shater marketplace app: 'Craftsman' persona key needs slide with two Arabic phone screens
whatItIs: A pale lavender-blue slide with 'Key Needs' and a persona header 'الحـرفي — صاحب الخبرة' (The Craftsman — the experienced one), five pill bullet points on access to jobs and managing offers, a large faded 'Shater' wordmark, a construction worker in a hard hat and orange vest, and two Arabic phone screens (services search, request stats).
whatItMeans: Research-grounded and human; the persona quote and real photo make the user need concrete.
techniques: Pair a persona statement with pill bullet needs.
Fade the wordmark large behind the hero photo.
Show two supporting phone screens beside the person.

vocabulary.definition: A fictional user representing a segment of real users.
The core problems a persona must solve.
